_comment: ÓRBITA library (libraries.content of orbita.config.json), as in the reference ÓRBITA site. The parent site area has the Setting template: its fields (fields.json) are only filled when empty, so the values changed in the portal are kept. Images of the fields: theme/images/<image>.

footerBrand._comment: HTML component <component> at the root of Components, called by the footer content of the theme library (under the company logo): ÓRBITA logo and "Powered by HCL Software", with the images of headerTop.

headerTop._comment: HTML component <component> at the root of Components (the HeaderContent field calls it). Its {{image:<file>}} marks become the DAM URL of theme/images/<file> in the collection damCollection if the portal has DAM, otherwise the image component <component> of Components/<imageFolder>.
